blocks.text: Bela Padilla announced that she and tech CEO Martin Tan have decided to end their relationship and move forward separately after eight months of dating. Padilla shared the update in an Instagram post on Sunday, Sept. 27, describing Tan as someone she will always be grateful to have shared a relationship with. “I’m deciding for both of us to move forward separately to save whatever we can of ourselves and how we see each other,” Padilla wrote.
